summary: Unlock the secrets of fixed-income markets with our comprehensive training. Learn analysis and valuation techniques to elevate your financial career.
lede: Fixed-Income Analysis and Valuation provides a structured way to assess debt instruments, model yield curves, quantify credit risk, and evaluate the effects of interest rate movements. You will develop practical skills in bond pricing, credit spread analysis, embedded options, and portfolio attribution to support more resilient investment and balance sheet decisions. The course focuses on applying concepts through spot rate curve construction, duration gap calculations, Option-Adjusted Spread and Credit Default Swap pricing, and derivative-linked valuation. It also includes practical workflows, templates, and reporting frameworks designed to help professionals deliver consistent valuations and risk analysis in demanding market conditions.
audienceIntro: This program is specifically designed for finance professionals who operate within the debt capital markets and require a rigorous, practitioner-led approach to valuation and risk management.
modules: Fixed-Income Market Structure and Instrument Mechanics
Interest Rate Risk and Sensitivity Analysis
Term Structure Analysis and Curve Construction
Valuation of Bonds with Embedded Options
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial mathematics and be proficient in Microsoft Excel. Familiarity with basic financial statements and the concept of the time value of money is required. Access to a laptop with Excel is mandatory for the quantitative exercises. While not required, prior exposure to the Bloomberg Terminal or Reuters Eikon is beneficial.
